scripts.list: echo "Liste des plugins téléchargés :" && cd src/plugins && ls -l | grep ^d | awk '{print $9}'
scripts.update:
cd src/plugins && for plugin in $(cat ../files/plugins.list); do plugin_name=$(echo $plugin | cut -d'/' -f2); if [ -d "../plugins/$plugin_name" ]; then echo "\033[32m Plugin $plugin_name already downloaded !  \033[0m"; else git clone https://github.com/$plugin; echo "\033[32m Plugin $plugin added successfully ! \033[0m 
"; fi done && echo "
\033[32m Downloading updates... Please wait... \033[0m 
" && for folder in $(ls -l | grep ^d | awk '{print $9}'); do cd $folder; git pull -q; cd ..; if ! grep -oq $folder$ ../files/plugins.list; then rm -r $folder; echo "\033[32m Plugin $folder removed successfully ! \033[0m
"; fi done && cd ../.. && echo "\033[32m Plugins from files/plugins.list added/removed/updated successfully ! \033[0m 
"
scripts.rebase:
cd src/ && rm -r plugins && mkdir plugins && cd plugins && for plugin in $(cat ../files/plugins.list); do git clone https://github.com/$plugin; done && cd ../.. && echo "
\033[32m Successfully rebased from files/plugins.list ! \033[0m 
"
scripts.first:
cd src/ && mkdir plugins && cd plugins && for plugin in $(cat ../files/plugins.list); do git clone https://github.com/$plugin; done && cd ../.. && echo "
\033[32m Successfully installed from files/plugins.list ! \033[0m 
"
scripts.list_win: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p='src/plugins'; Write-Host 'Liste des plugins téléchargés :'; Get-ChildItem $p -Directory | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }"
scripts.update_win: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$root=(Get-Location); $plugins=Join-Path $root 'src/plugins'; $list=Join-Path $root 'src/files/plugins.list'; $repos=Get-Content $list | Where-Object { $_.Trim() -ne '' }; Set-Location $plugins; foreach ($repo in $repos) { $name=($repo -split '/')[1]; $path=Join-Path $plugins $name; if (Test-Path $path) { Write-Host \" Plugin $name already downloaded ! \" -ForegroundColor Green } else { git clone \"https://github.com/$repo\"; Write-Host \" Plugin $name added successfully ! \" -ForegroundColor Green } }; Write-Host \"`n Downloading updates... Please wait... `n\" -ForegroundColor Green; Get-ChildItem $plugins -Directory | ForEach-Object { $name=$_.Name; Set-Location $_.FullName; git pull -q; Set-Location $plugins; $expected=$repos | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '/')[1] }; if ($expected -notcontains $name) { Remove-Item $_.FullName -Recurse -Force; Write-Host \" Plugin $name removed successfully !`n\" -ForegroundColor Green } }; Set-Location $root; Write-Host \" Plugins from files/plugins.list added/removed/updated successfully ! `n\" -ForegroundColor Green"
scripts.rebase_win: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$root=(Get-Location); $plugins=Join-Path $root 'src/plugins'; $list=Join-Path $root 'src/files/plugins.list'; if (Test-Path $plugins) { Remove-Item $plugins -Recurse -Force }; New-Item $plugins -ItemType Directory | Out-Null; Get-Content $list | Where-Object { $_.Trim() -ne '' } | ForEach-Object { git -C $plugins clone \"https://github.com/$_\" }; Write-Host \"`n Successfully rebased from files/plugins.list ! `n\" -ForegroundColor Green"
scripts.first_win: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$root=(Get-Location); $plugins=Join-Path $root 'src/plugins'; $list=Join-Path $root 'src/files/plugins.list'; New-Item $plugins -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null; Get-Content $list | Where-Object { $_.Trim() -ne '' } | ForEach-Object { git -C $plugins clone \"https://github.com/$_\" }; Write-Host \"`n Successfully installed from files/plugins.list ! `n\" -ForegroundColor Green"
